definitions.explanation: The owner or manager of a shop, restaurant, or small business. Implies hands-on involvement in running the establishment.

examples.japanese: {店主|てんしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The proprietor cooks the food himself.

examples.japanese: {店主|てんしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気|き}さく→気さく：07158_kisaku⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧で、⟦{常連客|じょうれんきゃく}→常連客：26808_jourenkyaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The shop owner is a friendly person and gets along well with regulars.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三代目|さんだいめ}→三代目：25201_sandaime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{店主|てんしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こだわり→こだわり：08346_kodawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}っている→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: The third-generation proprietor uses carefully selected ingredients to preserve the traditional flavor.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for owners of small, individually operated businesses — ramen shops, cafes, bookstores, etc. Larger businesses typically use ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧ (president) or ⟦{経営者|けいえいしゃ}→経営者：16188_keieisha⟧ (manager/operator). {店主|てんしゅ} conveys a personal, hands-on quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {店主|てんしゅ}⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧: the owner's recommendation
- {店主|てんしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こだわり→こだわり：08346_kodawari⟧: the owner's particular commitment
- {店主|てんしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: the owner changes
- ⟦{先代|せんだい}→先代：14793_sendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{店主|てんしゅ}: the previous owner
